title: Single-Cell RNA Cell-Type Annotation

engineFeatures.meaning: the feature that best separates the classes
the feature on which classes 2 and 3 barely differ

label: For "Single-Cell RNA Cell-Type Annotation": Annotate millions of cells with cell types automatically, flagging novel populations for biologists. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test batches seen in training.
